title: Hilton Invites New Yorkers to Drop Everything and ‘Whisk Away’ on a Mystery Getaway
summary: The experience is happening on the doorstep of the Nasdaq MarketSite, where the company is ringing the opening bell to highlight its next chapter of innovation and growth.

- **Today, Thursday, November 5, Hilton is bringing its “New Ways to Stay” campaign to Times Square, where eligible travelers can enter for a chance to be whisked away on a mystery getaway and discover where their next stay could take them.**
- **New Hilton research finds 81% of U.S. adults would drop everything for a free dream vacation, while 79% would take an all-expenses-paid mystery trip.**
- **The experience is happening on the doorstep of the Nasdaq MarketSite, where the company is ringing the opening bell to highlight its next chapter of innovation and growth.**


**MCLEAN, Va. –** Six travelers are about to get the chance to drop everything and be whisked away on a mystery solo getaway. Today in Times Square, Hilton is bringing its[New Ways to Stay campaign](https://www.hilton.com/en/p/new-ways-to-stay/) to life with a one-day pop-up where eligible travelers can enter for a chance to win one of six mystery solo getaways.


## Americans are Ready to Drop Everything


New research from Hilton and Morning Consult shows Americans are ready to say yes to an escape: 81% of U.S. adults would drop everything for a free dream vacation. Meanwhile, 79% would take an all-expenses-paid mystery trip—including 44% who would go without hesitation—with interest even higher among parents (87%) and employed adults (86%). The appeal goes beyond a change of scenery.[Hilton’s 2027 Trends Report](https://stories.hilton.com/2027-trends) found that 41% of travelers plan to take a solo trip in the next year, with relaxing and recharging the leading motivation.


## Whisk Away Sweepstakes


As part of the activation, Hilton is inviting travelers to participate in its Whisk Away sweepstakes, giving winners time away from everyday demands to relax and recharge on a solo escape. Ready for a little mystery? The first 150 travelers who sign up at[www.HiltonWhiskAway.com](https://www.hiltonwhiskaway.com/) between now and 12:15 p.m. ET and attend the Times Square event at West 43rd Street & 7th Avenue between 11:45 a.m. and 12:45 p.m. ET will be eligible to win one of six mystery getaways.


“Sometimes the best trips are the ones you don’t overthink,” said Dan Reynolds, senior vice president, Global Marketing, Hilton. “This activation is about giving travelers the ultimate excuse to drop everything, embrace the unexpected and take some well-deserved time for themselves. It brings our latest campaign, New Ways to Stay, to life in a way that’s surprising, personal and unmistakably Hilton.”


There, two hotel-inspired installations will give visitors a glimpse at the unexpected stays they can discover across Hilton’s growing portfolio, from boutique hideaways and design-led hotels to resorts and outdoor escapes. The pop-up event will feature experiences inspired by Hilton’s New Ways to Stay campaign and properties around the world, including[Maison Heler Metz, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/etzmhqq-maison-heler-metz/) and[La Valise Tulum, an SLH hotel](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/cunlvlx-la-valise-tulum/) . Six winners will be selected and notified by 1:45 p.m. ET to return to Time Square with their passport in-hand to be whisked away to a surprise destination.


## Marking Hilton’s Move to Nasdaq


The one-day experience is happening on the doorstep of the Nasdaq MarketSite, where Hilton today will ring the opening bell to highlight its next chapter of innovation and growth. Hilton has[transferred](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-announces-planned-transfer-of-stock-listing-to-nasdaq) its common stock listing, HLT, from the New York Stock Exchange to Nasdaq, marking the latest milestone in the company’s evolution as an innovative, fast-growing hospitality leader.


For more information, or to book your next stay, visit[Hilton.com](https://www.hilton.com/en/) .


##### FAQ: Hilton Invites New Yorkers to Drop Everything and ‘Whisk Away’ on a Mystery Getaway


The New Ways to Stay experience is a one-day Hilton activation on November 5 in Times Square, at West 43rd Street and Seventh Avenue, near Nasdaq MarketSite. The experience will feature hotel-inspired installations and the opportunity for eligible travelers to enter the sweepstakes.


In an October 2026 survey conducted by Hilton and Morning Consult among 1,003 U.S. adults, 80% said they need a break before the holidays start. The survey also found that 81% would drop everything for a free dream vacation, while 79% would take an all-expenses-paid mystery trip—including 44% who would go without hesitation. According to Hilton’s[2027 Trends Report](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1b7BE3anzmRH3tr4vDKKFgbBQNj33W_Lp/view?usp=sharing) , travelers are increasingly travelers are increasingly defining trips on their own terms, leaving more room for flexibility and spontaneity rather than planning every moment.


The timing brings two parts of Hilton’s story together: a new chapter for the company’s stock listing and new ways for travelers to discover Hilton stays. The activation gives the *New Ways to Stay* campaign a tangible expression in Times Square.

## About Hilton


Hilton (Nasdaq: HLT) is a leading global hospitality company with a portfolio of 28 world-class brands comprising more than 9,600 properties and over 1.4 million rooms, in 144 countries and territories. Dedicated to fulfilling its founding vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality, Hilton has welcomed over 4 billion guests in its more than 100-year history. Named as the No. 1 World’s Best Workplace by Great Place to Work and Fortune, Hilton aims to create the best culture for its 500,000 team members around the world. Hilton has introduced industry-leading technology enhancements to improve the guest experience, including Digital Key Share, automated complimentary room upgrades and the ability to book confirmed connecting rooms. Through the award-winning guest loyalty program Hilton Honors, the more than 270 million Hilton Honors members who book directly with Hilton can earn Points for hotel stays and experiences money can't buy. With the free[Hilton Honors app](https://www.hilton.com/en/p/hilton-honors-mobile-app/) , guests can book their stay, select their room, check in, unlock their door with a Digital Key and check out, all from their smartphone.
